accounting.counts: every simulator process, including -h, version, syntax probes, failures, crashes, aborts and sub-calls made inside the runner
accounting.no_refund: a failure costs the budget; recovery never refunds it
accounting.reserve_before_start: REQUESTED is persisted before the process starts
accounting.single_executor: one executor runs at a time and re-reads the on-disk account inside the lock
accounting.uncertain_kept: an uncertain request keeps its charge

approval_note: the user replied YES on 2026-10-26 (Asia/Shanghai) to this task book with the two ceilings below; the same scope is not asked for again

carried_followups.text: vss is a required signal alongside the supplies; this round carries it in every new extraction and observation list
the ideal iprobe two-terminal check uses 1e-06 V plus 1e-09 times the magnitude, is proven readable in this machine export precision, and is not a device drop spec

cases.purpose: 000..111 eight 1 us emission windows, per-step settling and tail
lowest non-zero code on a 120 ns pulse
lowest non-zero code on a 200 ns pulse
011 -> 100 -> 000 -> 111, code changes only inside the shutoff region
joint PWM/PAM charge driven by the accepted RTL four-state VCD at a 120 ns tick
cases.source_deck: NEW: derived from the accepted RTL four-state VCD

cases.purpose: joint PWM/PAM charge driven by the accepted RTL four-state VCD at a 200 ns tick
cases.source_deck: NEW: derived from the accepted RTL four-state VCD

forbidden_denominators: the length of the window under test
the measured Q of that window
the code current of that window multiplied by its length
I111 / 8 substituted for the nominal denominator
charge.t50_rule: T50 is only the interval between the actual 0.9 V crossings of the enable for that window; for the safety window it is the actual falling edge after the abort

convergence.also_report: absolute dQ in coulombs and femtocoulombs per window
convergence.proves: nothing about whether the waveform itself meets an electrical requirement
uncovered: TR-200 has no dedicated fine-step partner, so no claim is made that every case has an independent fine-step check
HYB-120 and HYB-200 have no fine-step pair of their own

dc_reference.known_dc_bias: the accepted DC round measures I111 at 1.20 V as 1.538270557e-05 A, +2.551370 % above the 1.5e-05 A nominal, so a long or full-bright window may exceed 0.5 LSB on the nominal error and that is a reported result
dc_reference.rule: IDC(k) is the I_sink_A column of the 1.20 V DUT row of each code in the accepted DC table, read at run time rather than copied from a display column

form_proven_on_this_build.netlist_dir: the run payload exports QODER_NETLIST_DIR; the old environment file is not touched

deck_rules.include_target: the six accepted stripped masters listed below
deck_rules.native_time: adaptive native samples keep float precision, are strictly increasing and finite, and carry their declared unit; they are never rounded to ps nor assumed equally spaced

preflight.also_read_back: the input PWL levels, edges and bit order from the native output
preflight.drops: the hierarchical saves of a DUT that is not present
preflight.not_a_claim: an ideal resistive preflight does not switch off with DATA_EN, so it is never a shutoff or ladder result

deck_rules.run_copies_only: this round runs only copies under spectre/dd1_d7c_b_tr; the frozen PREP deck text is never edited
unchanged: the declared physical inputs of a step-size pair

electrical_environment.ideal_clamp_note: the clamp is an ideal test condition, not a real LED, scan high side or electrode RC
electrical_environment.iref_form: external 15 uA injected into the frozen diode-connected reference
electrical_environment.model_source: the environment variables the accepted rounds already used; no model card, vendor path or licence value is copied into this repository
electrical_environment.vss_form: explicit 0 V vsource, present in the delivered deck

frozen.candidate_duts_and_derived_masters: the four candidate DUTs, the six stripped masters and the fifteen PREP decks are frozen
frozen.data_and_pam_polarity: Data drives the LED N side and the scan high side drives the P side; the polarity is not changed
frozen.dut_geometry_body_and_reference_structur: unchanged; no W/L/body edit is authorised
frozen.prep_contract_state: the PROPOSED bytes are kept byte-identical; this contract carries the frozen decision and its source

conversion.edge_shape: a hold/ramp point pair per edge, the 50 % point aligned to the original VCD edge
conversion.forbidden: slow interpolation across an emission window
conversion.self_recheck: the converted PWL is re-parsed and every original edge, bit order, 2 ns slope and initial level is confirmed; overlapping edges are refused
conversion.shift_rule: the whole waveform moves right, enable and PAM together
conversion.xz_rule: any X or Z, and any illegal protocol, is refused before the analogue run

hybrid.driven_by: the real four-state VCD of the accepted rtl/dd1_d7a_gray_ctrl.sv at base
hybrid.expectation_source: the independent expectation is built from the input codes and the measured tick stream, not copied from the DUT target arithmetic
hybrid.frame_F63_note: cfg_hyb_time == 63 maps to FULL_HYB = 64 intervals in the accepted RTL, so M = 64 and not 63
hybrid.normal_frame_rule: data_en conducts over [t0, t0 + M*T), pam holds for the whole frame and its tail, and the frame ends with 65 boundary events
not_a_claim: not a MOS implementation of the RTL controller
not physical CDC or skew verification
protocol: release reset, change mode to 01 in the safe phase and hold at least two reference periods
cfg_valid low then high, complete a new load, wait at least one sampling edge, then LATCH
one more sampling edge, then START
the first tick is consumed only after blank is released
tick is set ahead on the falling edge and consumed on the rising edge; config, latch and START never crowd onto the same edge
wait for win_state DONE every frame, including a zero code, which still walks all 64 intervals, keep the tick at least two more times, then prepare the next frame
at least 500 ns of preparation and tail under DATA_EN = 0 between frames
a code change finishes at least 100 ns before the next DATA_EN rising edge

safety_frame.after_withdrawal: inside blank only START is issued, no load and no LATCH, ticks continue and at least 600 ns must stay black
safety_frame.measured_as: the actual fault closing edge, never the planned 64 T

hybrid.single_channel_instance: one instance only per VCD, no new RTL function, the controller is not modified
hybrid.t0: the reference clk rising edge that consumes the tick, never the obs_tick that leads it

window_count.rule: four normal frames per group plus the HYB-120 safety frame; the two zero codes have no emission edge and are listed as black windows

internal_nodes.branch_count_rule: checked against k+1 conducting branches, with an unselected branch local bias distinguished from a selected one
internal_nodes.no_device_op_parameters: this build saves node values only, so no MOS region, SOA or saturation sign-off is claimed from a node name
internal_nodes.per_step_observation: TR-LONG reports at least 50 ns of time-weighted observation at the end of every flat step: the eight en/enb logics, the eight vbias_ch, the shared iref_in and a representative node_m
internal_nodes.switch_and_off: the internal nodes and the output current are shown together and the delay is attributed to decode, bias charge/discharge or current build-up; where the evidence does not reach, the report says it was not attributed

probe.definition: I_sink = Ip_branch with no negation and no abs()

ideal_two_terminal_check.earlier_round_not_rewritten: the accepted DC round keeps its published 20 mV guard and value; only this adapter carries the tightened rule
ideal_two_terminal_check.must_be_proven_readable: this round proves the tolerance is expressible in the exported precision before using it as a check

probe.order_rule: Ip_branch (clamp_node data_out) iprobe, the order the accepted bench uses
probe.tail_sign: a shutoff tail keeps its own sign; Q, Qpos and abs(Qneg) are reported separately and never cancel

current: the Ip_branch current column under its real native name
required_signals.missing_internal_node_rule: output measurements already obtained may be kept, but the complete internal observation status is PARTIAL and no full stage PASS is granted for it; the schematic is never redrawn for it
required_signals.missing_named_rule: a name that does not exist is named in the refusal; no contract value is substituted, no observation is claimed and no DUT port is repurposed to make an export appear
required_signals.note: carry-over followup F-TR-1 from the DC-R1 limited GO: vss is listed as a required signal beside the supplies at the same level in every new extraction and observation list of this round
required_signals.pre_run_check: before each native launch the save list and the model naming are checked read-only, and the first DUT run checks the internal columns too, so nine cases are not run to discover a missing observation

black_window.post_fault_hold: the 600 ns after the fault withdrawal is its own black window
black_window.rule: a zero-code window has no emission edge: Q and max(abs(I)) are measured over the whole 64-tick window, Qtarget is 0, the QLSB is the same fixed one, and no T50 is invented

settling.deadline: flat_stop of this window, the start of the falling ramp
settling.short_window: NOT_SETTLED_WITHIN_PULSE, the deadline is never moved

windows.source_of_truth: the PWL text of the run copy; the five kinds are re-derived from it and compared with the frozen windows table, so the generator is never its own witness

tail.window: the last 100 ns of the pure-off window
